raw_text: As farmers march towards Delhi, a parallel battle is being fought online with AI-generated images inflating crowd estimates. Multiple fact-checkers have identified synthetic photographs showing impossibly large gatherings. The actual turnout, while substantial, is being distorted by AI imagery shared primarily through Telegram and WhatsApp. This marks a new chapter in the use of generative AI in Indian protest movements.
